(4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET - SUSPEND THE OTHER DRIVER INSTEAD. **40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE - GIVE EVERY STARTUP ASSERTION AN IN-GAME READBACK.**

# 75. WALL RISERS, SCOPE A — a-h; §75.h BUILT + UNVERIFIED

Core record as prior revisions (4 defs, riser IS Building_ABColumn, WallLamp attachment, no holdsRoof, cascade despawn, north-face uiIconPaths). Chain: **a** own-cell stub → unconditional in-cell hide. **b** up-cell stub → below-cell clause. **c** impossible toggles → `TypeHasNetworks()`. **d** ATTEMPTED Dubs-layer fix, **NEVER ACTUALLY BOUND - see h**. **e** §62.J revoked → one unconditional clause. **f** no `researchPrerequisites`; architect uiOrder links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083.

**§75.g - THE PROBE.** `AB2: carrier probe` (DebugActionType.ToolMap): click a cell, get every thing with def/class/drawerType/`IsCarrier`/`ShouldPrint`, an explicit DYNAMIC DRAW flag when a carrier is not `MapMeshOnly`, the foreign print-binding census, and a live **patch census** built from `Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods()` + `GetPatchInfo(m).Prefixes[].owner`. Built because four static facts contradicted the symptom and reading could not say which was false.

**§75.h - THE ACTUAL BUG (run #347).** The probe's census listed exactly two patched print methods: `Verse.SectionLayer_ThingsGeneral` (ourPrefix=True) and `RimWorld.SectionLayer_ThingsPowerGrid` (someone else's). **Not one Dubs layer was patched.** Decompiling settled why: `Rimefeller.SectionLayer_ThingsPipe` and `DubsBadHygiene.SectionLayer_ThingsSewagePipe` (identical shared Dubwise code) derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, and override `Regenerate()` to walk the cells calling **`Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid(SectionLayer)`**. §75.d's `DeclaredMethod(layer, "TakePrintFrom")` was always null → silent `continue`. The print entry point is on the THING, not the layer.

⚠ AND THE TRIPWIRE HAD BEEN FIRING ALL ALONG. Player.log holds both rule-33 lines ("...is loaded but none of its pipe layers could be patched") for DBH and Rimefeller, every session since §75.d. It fires from `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`, BEFORE the diagnostic bridge attaches, so it only ever reached the file. Rule 40.

**THE FIX.** `ABForeignPipeLayerHide` now patches `<Host>.Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid` per host (DBH / Rimefeller / Rimatomics), deduped by MethodInfo in case of a shared base. ⚠ The prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument: one method serves both the normal-view layer and the host's `*Overlay` layers, so it refuses only when the layer type is in a resolved `NormalViewLayers` set - anything unrecognised prints, so a future rename leaks art rather than hiding connectivity (rule 34, fail-safe direction). `__instance` is typed `Thing` and the layer is bound by index (`__0`), so no foreign type appears in any signature. A `Census` string records per-host binding and is read back by `AB2: network scan` AND the carrier probe.

⚠ Doctrine, restated harder: no loose plumbing in normal view on EVERY host's print path (rule 16, applied to METHODS not layers); overlays carry connectivity (rule 34); never classify a foreign layer - or its print entry point - without decompiling it.

**TEMP ART:** 12 PNGs, shipping as-is by user decision. **FINAL ART - GEMINI PAUSED r5.**
